about:
Most Shopify founders hit the same wall.

Traffic is growing. Orders are coming in. But the store still feels fragile.

Pages slow down under traffic. Checkout leaks revenue. New features break something else.

And scaling becomes harder than it should be.

That’s when many brands realize something important.

Scaling a Shopify store isn’t just about marketing. It’s about engineering the store for growth.

I didn’t start my journey trying to become a Shopify consultant. I started by solving complex ecommerce problems — fixing broken storefronts, optimizing checkout experiences, and rebuilding Shopify stores that couldn’t handle scale.

Over time one pattern became clear.

The brands that scale to 8–9 figures don’t just run Shopify stores. They build high-performance ecommerce systems.

Stores engineered for conversion. Infrastructure designed for growth. Customer journeys optimized for revenue.

That’s the work I focus on today.

I help enterprise DTC brands scale their Shopify stores to 8–9 figures through Shopify Plus development, conversion rate optimization, and high-performance ecommerce architecture.

This isn’t about adding another app or redesigning a page.

It’s about turning your Shopify store into a revenue engine that scales with your brand.

A few things clients say about working with me:

“Mazhar did a phenomenal job and consistently went above and beyond expectations. He was proactive, solution-oriented, and always willing to walk the extra mile.” 

— Abdul Basit, Founder at Cukatu

“Works quickly and accurately. When encountering challenges, they know how to handle them well and offer good alternatives and advice.” 

— Sterre De Vries, CEO at Starwise

If you run a growing Shopify or Shopify Plus brand and want to remove the technical bottlenecks slowing your growth, book a Shopify CRO & Growth Audit from my Featured section or send me a message here.
